figures.name: Radien-attje

ability.name: Sky Father's Decree
ability.description: Restore all ally stats to their maximum values for 1 turn.

figures.description: The supreme sky father who created and governs the universe from his heavenly dwelling above all worlds.

figures.name: Radien-akka

ability.name: Life Breath
ability.description: Resurrect one fallen ally at half HP; grant all allies +1 to all stats.

figures.description: The great sky mother who gives the soul its final form and sends it into the human body at birth.

figures.name: Jabmeaakka

ability.name: Jabme's Domain
ability.description: Deal 3 dark damage per turn to all enemies for 2 turns.

figures.description: Mistress of Jabmiaibme, the underground realm of the dead, who receives and houses all departed souls.

figures.name: Baiwe

ability.name: Arctic Sun
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; grant immunity to cold and ice effects for 2 turns.

figures.description: Sun goddess who drives her reindeer across the arctic sky bringing warmth, healing and the renewal of life.

figures.name: Tiermes

ability.name: Thunder Bow
ability.description: Deal 6 damage to one evil spirit; protect all allies from dark abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: Thunder god who shoots his bow to drive away evil spirits and protect the Sami people from harm.

figures.name: Noaidi

ability.name: Sacred Drum Flight
ability.description: Travel to the spirit world: look at all enemy cards and copy one ability.

figures.description: The Sami shaman who uses the sacred drum to fly to the spirit world, heal the sick and negotiate with deities.

figures.name: Stallo

ability.name: Iron Body
ability.description: Reduce all incoming damage by 3; deal 5 damage on attack, but slow by 2.

figures.description: Massive evil giant of Sami mythology who hunts humans, can be outsmarted but never outfought directly.

figures.name: Saivo

ability.name: Mirror Lake
ability.description: Copy all stats and abilities of one enemy and apply them to one ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: Spiritual doubles who live in underground mirror-lakes and can be summoned by the noaidi as powerful helpers.

figures.name: Ailekes eadni

ability.name: Reindeer Herd
ability.description: All animal and nature allies gain +3 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: Divine mother of the reindeer who ensures the abundance and fertility of the herds upon which Sami life depends.

figures.name: Lieaibolmmai

ability.name: Bear Ritual
ability.description: After defeating an enemy creature, this card gains +2 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: Lord of the hunt and bears whose permission must be sought before hunting and who receives the first kill.

figures.name: Ruto

ability.name: Plague Touch
ability.description: Inflict disease on one enemy: they lose 1 HP per turn and cannot be healed for 2 turns.

figures.description: Evil spirit of disease who enters sleeping bodies and rides them to exhaustion, sent by the god of the dead.

figures.name: Maderakka

ability.name: Akka's Gift
ability.description: When any ally is summoned, they enter with +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Primary among the four akka goddesses who governs the female sphere and assists in the creation of children.

figures.name: Juoksahkka

ability.name: Arrow of Gender
ability.description: Change one card's alignment; that card gains the abilities of its new alignment type.

figures.description: Arrow goddess who determines a child's gender in the womb and to whom offerings are made for healthy births.

figures.name: Ruohtta

ability.name: Death Ride
ability.description: Inflict weakening disease on all enemies; each loses 1 power per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: God of disease who rides a supernatural horse and spreads illness across the land.

figures.name: Arctic Fox Spirit

ability.name: Aurora Tail
ability.description: Dash: deal 3 damage to all enemies in a line; move to a safe position.

figures.description: The magical arctic fox whose bushy tail brushes the northern mountains to create the aurora borealis.

figures.name: Seite

ability.name: Votive Offering
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies at the start of each turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: Sacred stone or stump that acts as a local deity receiving offerings of reindeer fat and blood.

figures.name: Uksakka

ability.name: Threshold Ward
ability.description: Prevent one enemy from entering play this turn.

figures.description: Goddess of the doorway who protects the household against evil spirits attempting to cross the threshold.

figures.name: Bear Spirit

ability.name: Bearskin Armor
ability.description: Grant one ally bear-form: +2 defense and immunity to cold for 1 turn.

figures.description: The sacred bear who is both animal and returning ancestor spirit, treated with utmost ceremony after the hunt.

figures.name: Chabrineädni

ability.name: Iron Sickness
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's defense by 3; they cannot recover defense for 1 turn.

figures.description: The iron mother who sends iron sickness into human bodies, a disease requiring shamanic removal.

figures.name: Ancestor Drum

ability.name: Drum Map
ability.description: Reveal all hidden information on the field; copy one ability from any card.

figures.description: The sacred shamanic drum painted with the map of the cosmos, through which the noaidi travels all worlds.
